errors.evidence: Description states the 'Full FT' bar reaches approximately 6 × 10^19 FLOPs, but the figure shows it is higher, around 8 × 10^19 FLOPs.
'TAG' and 'Adapter' bars are reported as approximately 2 × 10^19 FLOPs, but 'TAG' is slightly higher than 'Adapter', closer to 2.2 × 10^19 FLOPs.
'MTL-FT' is described as roughly 3 × 10^18 FLOPs, but it appears closer to 4 × 10^18 FLOPs in the figure.
'QAdapter' bar is said to be approximately 1.5 × 10^18 FLOPs, but it is closer to 2 × 10^18 FLOPs.
'Ours' is reported as approximately 1.7 × 10^18 FLOPs, while it looks closer to 1.9 × 10^18 FLOPs.
The description fails to mention that the scale is logarithmic, which is crucial for interpreting the data.
The description does not summarize the main insight drawn from the comparison of methods, such as the cost-effectiveness of 'Ours' relative to others.
The phrase 'the first five bars' could be clearer by specifying which methods are being referred to directly.
